claims.statement: Replay of held allocations failed because pickup slots were not corrected before re-booking; orders were re-booked into expired slot windows and remain held
claims.corroboration: Observability confirmed replay attempted before slot correction; orders remain held in closed slots
claims.limitation: Confirms the operational sequence failed; does not address the underlying slot duration configuration

claims.statement: The root cause of the 186 stuck orders is that split-reservation orders (v18 EXC-0921) are booked with 30-minute pickup slot windows, but carrier confirmation latency is 47 minutes median, causing confirmations to arrive after slots close
claims.corroboration: Handoff trace explicitly measures timing mismatch (30 min slot vs 47 min confirmation). Orders booked before rule change succeeded; one re-booked order with corrected slots succeeded. Issue coincides with v18 deployment at 22:00.
claims.limitation: The specific code/config causing slot duration mismatch is not identified; requires investigation into booking system configuration

capability_gaps.reason: To understand whether v18 changed slot duration settings, or whether the slot mismatch is in the booking system configuration independent of v18

next_action.rationale: Root cause (C20) is established with discriminating evidence: slot duration mismatch (30 min booking vs 47 min confirmation latency) specific to split-reservation orders created by v18. Authorized operational mitigations (slot correction, revert, replay) have all been attempted but failed due to implementation barriers (wrong feed, no pre-correction, slot config unchanged). The issue requires investigation and correction of the slot duration configuration in the booking system or v18 rule definition, which is beyond the scope of operational mitigation. A detailed root cause and remediation path has been established.
next_action.expected_information_gain: Assessment complete; root cause established; operational mitigations exhausted; recommendation is to investigate slot duration configuration and code changes.
